tasks.blocked_on: A COST DECISION THE USER OWNS. --regrid is adopted on THIRTEEN files (IK_plus joined at bc01875) entirely BY HAND, because `fidelity_better` cannot select it: every FIDELITY.md column compares WHAT is played, and a tune playing the right music 0.78% fast forever scores perfectly.
